ticket_eligibility: every constituent horse has 8 <= result-file closing winOdds < 15
selection: among eligible tickets, maximize model event probability minus closing-win-q proxy event probability
market_comparator: among the same eligible tickets, maximize closing-win-q proxy event probability
no_bet_rule: skip a race/bet type when too few eligible horses exist to form the ticket
settlement: official KRA final dividend, one-unit flat stake, no takeout double deduction
limitations: closing win odds have no documented executable timestamp
complex-bet pre-race combination prices are unavailable
the band is a retained historical hypothesis, not fresh preregistration
different bet types have different race counts
